item.title: Unpacking President Trump’s Visit to China | State of Play
item.description: President Trump’s historic state visit to China came amid heightened geopolitical tension surrounding Iran, and both sides entered the talks with sharply different priorities. Even so, the summit produced a framework for deeper cooperation and delivered several economic gains.

item.title: AI Licensing Comes Full Circle
item.description: Aalok Mehta discusses the Trump administration’s recent interest in licensing frontier models, arguing that important implementation details remain unresolved since the idea was floated publicly in 2023.

item.title: Why China Is Now a Peer Competitor to the United States in Cyberspace
item.description: China has matured its cyber ecosystem in sophistication, scale, stealth, and strategy—now rivaling, and in some areas surpassing, the United States. Washington should use the window following Trump's Beijing visit to strengthen its response to China's cyber threat.

item.title: What did the Trump-Xi Summit Achieve?
item.description: The U.S.-China summit was expected to cover trade, investment, the war with Iran, and Taiwan. CSIS’s leading China experts assessed its outcomes in a special live episode of State of Play.

item.title: The Iran Conflict Illuminates Taiwan’s Unique Energy Security Challenge
item.description: The Iran war has exposed key challenges in Taiwan’s energy system. Taipei needs to address these challenges to successfully balance the need for more electricity, emissions mitigation, and greater resilience against supply disruptions.

item.title: Overturning the Endangerment Finding Threatens Americans’ Health, Wealth, and Security
item.description: In April, the rescission of the endangerment finding went into effect, eliminating the basis for the United States’ regulation of greenhouse gas emissions. Policymakers should not accept the long-term damage to Americans’ health in exchange for short-term economic gain.

item.title: How Are Perceptions of the U.S.-Mexico Relationship Changing?
item.description: CSIS Americas Program Senior Associate Andrew Rudman analyzes evolving Mexican perceptions of the United States and their impact on bilateral relations.

item.title: Lebanon and Israel Talks: Empowering Diplomacy Over Open-Ended Conflict
item.description: Lebanon-Israel talks represent a historic opportunity to build lasting security for both countries.
